title: Monterey Scavenger Hunt Adventure

blurb: Set off on a Monterey adventure filled with history, intrigue, and excitement! Explore the city’s fascinating past as the capital of Alta California, stroll along the famous Cannery Row, and discover the influential people who helped shape Monterey. Dive into the story behind the sardine canning industry, be amazed by the Monterey Bay Aquarium, and experience the city’s lively jazz and golf culture. From the first theater to the first public library, Monterey is full of stories waiting to be uncovered!
